about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (board files with their artwork, footprint geometry), 'fab' = fab_sha256 (what the manufacturer builds from: Gerber layers rasterised, drill hits, BOM and CPL rows – in the protocol header of a gate run with stage F). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (BT1, D1) checked a second time against the datasheet, independently – the agent electrical-reviewer in its own session
manual.note: M-1: OK for state 32d5c81476fedf7a409dfc2dc27ec89fb2aa962d711b8042ba451f0f0149ddb8; requirements met: R-1, R-2. Datasheets QJ.BS-6 760a7d67…, NCD0805R1 3a6caf35…, read again 2026-11-02.

manual.text: Regulatory review: circuit and parts against EU law for the purpose in the graph – the agent regulatory-reviewer in its own session. No finding 'block' open. Support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability, mechanics, operation, looks) on the manufacturing files of a gate run with this layout – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer. No finding 'block' open, every 'important' finding fixed or rejected by the owner
manual.note: M-5: OK for fab dbbe8aa2baf11e97d24082041de0ab284d64a78a2df4c1d6eddc02c0a6e83be6; layout 1f529013a56fea12747977d89132f5f3822c9562158d49190e9769a74420b338. Manufacturing files of gate run 20261101-084430 reviewed in full (run 20261031-130109 of f958da9a no longer on this machine, so no fab diff): mark 'remove' – no order number on the visible top; the new Freerouting routing – 4 nets, 16 pieces of 0.254 mm for at most 10.7 mA, 2 tented vias (0.305/0.61 mm, ring 0.152 mm), 0.256 mm to the pour, copper 0.5 mm from the edge, DRC 0; copper 91/93 % in 6/1 pieces, each on a pad or via, no floating copper; JLCPCB manufacturability including the round outline (one 48-chord loop) with two own tooling holes Ø 1.152 mm NPTH 2.86 mm from the edge, mask open, copper 1.83 mm away, stated in order.md as 'Added by Customer'; the cell's overhang strips and 9–10 mm lever room free, BT1's tabs within reach of the iron (thermal spokes, pads pre-tinned, nearest via 2.9 mm, tented, under the holder), D1 visible beside SW1; the label at (21.9, 38.2) and the BT1 designator 3.7 and 1.2 mm clear of the cell, at least 3.1 mm from the edge, off every pad; one '+' at (40.3, 24) 1.1 mm from BT1.1's opening. Noted for the owner: VBAT runs on the visible top as a 14.5 mm diagonal from SW1 to BT1.1 (taste). Afterwards the board file got the reviewer's guards – [looks] max_track_m = 0.05 and max_vias = 2, [routing] hand_solder_keep_mm = 2 – a new layout hash, the board as made unchanged.

manual.text: At JLCPCB after the upload: assembly preview – rotation and polarity of every polarised part (compare with polarity_<board>.png); BOM without missing parts; price
Acceptance test of every delivered board: visual check (BT1 and D1 the right way round), D1 lights while SW1 is pressed and is dark once it is released
